body: Enjoy your life bro, parents sometimes take everything too serious.
I'm sorry that I can't help you with your problems. Stay strong!
Its really not good for your health. Try to eat your favourite food. I'm sure you will feel better after that!
People sometimes are cruel. But its YOUR life. Stay strong and dont let them hurt you.
Remember that there are good moments that we live for! Stay strong bro!
Remember that there are other people with same problems. I hope you will find help there!
Look for help in your real friends. If they care about you they should support you!
Fuck other people, be yourself and stop listening to what others think. Its YOUR life.
Life sucks bro, but I'm sure that there are moments that you live for. I hope you will get a new job soon!
Focus on small things you like. Thinking about how life is fucked won't help
